decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed two-storey side and single-storey rear extensions, due to their size, position and appearance, and forward projection, would fail to be secondary to the size of the original house, would un-balance the original pair of semi detached houses and would detract from the original character of the house and the street scene, contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 and H.6.4. of the Council's Unitary Development Plan (December 2003) and the Residential Extension Guidelines (October 2003).

Condition : 2 - The proposed two-storey side and single-storey rear extensions, by reason of their size, design and position, would represent an obtrusive and overbearing development which would harm the living conditions of the adjoining occupiers, by reason of enclosure, shading and loss of outlook, contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 and H.6.4. of the Council's Unitary Development Plan (December 2003) and the Residential Extension Guidelines (October 2003).

Condition : 3 - The proposal would result in the loss of a garage and would fail to provide off-street parking provision in accordance with the Council's Parking Standards, which may result in conditions prejudicial to the free flow and safe movement of motorists and pedestrians in the area, contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 and T.1.4 of the Council's Unitary Development Plan (December 2003)
description: Erection of a two storey side extension and single storey rear extension to dwellinghouse
